changelog:
jedToolKit 27.0.1 introduces a redesigned on-device jedAI experience, performance overhauls across core diagnostic modules, expanded security databases, refined system customization, and all-new Home Screen widget capabilities.

jedAI Beta & Recents Widget: A flatter, cleaner conversation interface tailored to your accent color, featuring on-device processing indicators, automatic chat history, and a new Home Screen widget to view conversation details and quickly resume chats.

Refreshed Widget Design & Sync: Displays recent conversations in clean card-style rows with relative timestamps (“2h ago”), tinted icon badges, live auto-synchronization across devices/actions, and clearer troubleshooting for setup or sideloading issues.

Performance Overhauls: Lazy line rendering and command recall history in jedTerminal, paired with precompiled Metal shaders and unified memory buffers in jedBenchmark 2.

Enhanced Diagnostics: Expanded panic log database covering 38 signatures, background log processing, and pull-to-refresh support in jedTSSChecker.

jedUI 6.0 and Security: Profile photo synchronization across Settings, accent color persistence in App Setup, biometric verification for App Lock, and hardened protection routines in jedOSSecuCheck 4.1.

System Reliability: Automatic connection resumption and checksum retries for IPSW Downloader, alongside folder navigation fixes and duplicate handling in jedXIP.

This update includes performance improvements and security enhancements, and is recommended for all users.
